subject: AWS Marketplace product page — benefit claims, pricing SKU, and co-sell alignment
messages:
From: Katie Miller <katie.miller@amazon.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace page — small clarifications on claims and SKU

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for sending the draft product page earlier. A couple of quick items from the AWS marketplace content review and co-sell enablement team before we move to final verification:

- Benefit statements: we need one short benefit (<=90 chars) for the hero and two supporting bullets that are more outcome-oriented (customer impact) rather than architecture claims.
- Pricing/SKUs: please confirm the official SKU IDs and whether the offering is hourly, monthly, or annual billing. If you provide a CSV with the SKU/pricing matrix we can validate compatibility with the marketplace SKU format.
- Co-sell: to get co-sell badging we need a one-paragraph customer success story + contact at the customer (if available).

Can you send a revised one-pager and the SKU matrix by EOD Monday so I can slot the final review next Wednesday?

Thanks,
Katie Miller
AWS Marketplace Partner Specialist
Amazon Web Services

Attachment: marketplace-checklist-v2.pdf (attachment stub)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Katie Miller <katie.miller@amazon.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace page — small clarifications on claims and SKU

Katie — thanks for the clear notes. Attaching a refreshed product page draft and our SKU/pricing matrix. Quick answers up-front:

- Hero benefit: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and half the inference cost" (we can shorten — open to edits).
- Billing model: hourly listing for usage-based, plus an optional annual committed capacity SKU. See attached CSV.
- Customer story: Liam (Acme Analytics) gave verbal permission to share a short quote; included a 1-paragraph draft.

Next steps I propose: Vanessa to do a final copy QA for compliance-friendly language, Marissa to confirm co-sell eligibility and prepare the CO-SELL request doc, and I will upload final assets to the partner portal.

Thanks — attaching:
- redwood_aws_product_page_v1.docx
- sku_pricing_matrix.csv
- acme_short_case_study.txt (quote stub)

Jonas Weber
Senior GTM Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace page — small clarifications on claims and SKU

Quick pass from copy:
- Hero needs to be shorter and avoid superlatives. Suggest: "Predictable LLM inference at production scale."
- Supporting bullets (two): 1) "Sub-second median latency at 99% of traffic patterns." 2) "Reduce per-token inference cost via automatic batching & prefix caching."
- Remove direct mentions of specific hardware vendors and internal kernel names — AWS prefers outcome-first wording.

I also flagged two lines that could read like a guarantee ("half the inference cost") — replace with "up to 50% lower per-token cost on typical workloads" or cite an internal benchmark doc. I can make the edits in the doc and reshare by Friday morning.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Katie Miller <katie.miller@amazon.com>, liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace page — small clarifications on claims and SKU

Looping in co-sell checklist/status:
- Co-sell intake: we need the customer contact + proof point. Liam, can you confirm the Acme reference and provide a short metrics line (e.g., latency reduction, cost savings)?
- Legal/compliance check: avoid wording that implies SLA unless we have a formal SLA item in the Dedicated offering.
- Marketplace assets: product imagery looks good; we need a 16:9 hero PNG at 1920x1080 and the 1-paragraph customer blurb.

I started the HubSpot deal record and added the Marketplace stage. HubSpot: DEAL-3421. Katie, once we have the updated doc I can submit the co-sell request and attach the customer consent form.

Next milestone: final draft to Katie by Mon 2026-09-06 12:00 PT.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
GTM Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Katie Miller <katie.miller@amazon.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized marketplace copy, SKUs, and co-sell assets

Katie — attaching the updated assets per your checklist. Changes made:
- Hero: "Predictable LLM inference at production scale."
- Supporting bullets updated to outcome language and softer cost phrasing ("up to 50% lower per-token cost on typical workloads").
- Removed vendor-specific kernel references.
- Attached CSV contains two SKUs: REDWOOD-ONDEMAND-HR (hourly usage) and REDWOOD-DEDICATED-ANNUAL (annual committed).
- Included Acme one-paragraph blurb and contact info for co-sell release (Liam O'Connor, liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com).

Attachments:
- redwood_aws_product_page_v1.docx
- sku_pricing_matrix.csv
- acme_short_case_study.txt
- hero_1920x1080.png (asset uploaded to partner S3)

Next steps: Katie to confirm final compliance pass and confirm co-sell badge eligibility. Marissa will submit CO-SELL request once Katie signs off.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior GTM Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
